title: An owner raises the monthly AWS spend ceiling from the workspace
description:
## Found while sequencing `chatticus-1d68fb`

`PATCH /orgs/{tenant}/monthly-aws-spend-ceiling` exists (`http/app.py`) and Gherkin for `chatticus-43e64c` raises the ceiling via the **kernel**, not that route. There is no workspace control. Self-setup collects the ceiling once (`SelfSetupCrossAccountRolePanel`).

If crossing the ceiling converts an unbounded bill into **contact an operator**, that is a person-step in the invitation-rate math and the brake is not self-serve.

## Gherkin (draft)

```
Feature: Owner raises the monthly AWS spend ceiling
  As an organization owner
  I want to raise the monthly AWS spend ceiling from the workspace
  So that paused computer work can resume without an operator

  Scenario: An owner raises the ceiling through the product
    Given an enabled organization whose computer work is paused at its spend ceiling
    When the owner submits a higher ceiling from the workspace
    Then PATCH /orgs/{tenant}/monthly-aws-spend-ceiling succeeds
    And computer work is accepted again

  Scenario: A non-owner is refused
    Given an enabled organization with a monthly spend ceiling
    When a member who is not an owner submits a ceiling change from the workspace
    Then the change is refused
    And the ceiling is unchanged
```

## Done when

An owner on development raises the ceiling through the product (not the members CLI / kernel). Behavior in Gherkin first. Confirm on the `chatticus-1d68fb` live pass what a member can do next.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Settles the #337 kernel-vs-PATCH note. Sequence after `1d68fb` records what a member can do next. Do not implement until authorized.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Started 2026-09-30 (Ryan approved). Findings before coding: (1) the PATCH route has no Gherkin coverage at all; the 43e64c scenarios use the kernel. (2) GET /me gives the web app neither the user's role nor the ceiling, so the UI cannot tell an owner from a member. Plan: /me adds role and, for owners only, monthly_aws_spend_ceiling_usd; HTTP-level Gherkin for owner raise, non-owner refusal, invalid amount; a raise control inside the paused notice for owners (members see guidance to ask an owner instead of 'ask an operator'); web Gherkin through the harness. Known limit I will record: when the pause is 'meter unavailable' rather than 'ceiling exceeded', raising the ceiling does not resume work.

comments.author: home
comments.text: #374 merged (f8e3447) and deployed to dev. LIVE CHECK 2026-09-30 as ryan@anth.us on dev.chattic.us: the paused notice shows the raise form for the owner, prefilled with the current ceiling; entering 500 and submitting went through the real PATCH route (ceiling read back as 500) and showed 'Monthly AWS spend ceiling is now $500.' Two findings, filed separately: chatticus-43e336 (reloadMe triggers a full workspace reload; needs a fix) and chatticus-619ba0 (form offered when raising cannot help: on dev the pause was 'spend unavailable', so work stayed paused). Seed removed, dev org back to no ceiling. Leaving this card open until the reload bug is fixed and the flow re-verified.
